final_message:
Configured the requested IPv4 names and both MX records; all 40 PCs use resolver **pc34**. Existing connections, addresses and routes remain unchanged.

The artificial root is on pc1; TLD servers are pc2–pc5. Zone servers are pc6, pc8–pc10, pc12–pc15, pc21, pc32 and pc33. DNS files were created under their `etc/bind` directories; PC startup files and DNS server images in [lab.conf](/var/folders/84/zz92dr1178v8z_tvd_q2dfw40000gn/T/kathara-aut-gw6x8k0w/lab/lab.conf) were updated.

Static checks confirmed router LAN route coverage and resolver settings on all PCs. BIND checking tools were unavailable, and the running lab was not tested; DNS resolution still needs external validation.
